Understanding Cyperus Rotundus Powder

Nagarmotha, botanically Cyperus rotundus and also known as nutgrass, is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and herbal formulations. Our cyperus rotundus powder supplier network brings in raw tubers from trusted growers. We select mature tubers and clean them. Then we dehydrate them under controlled conditions. Next, the dried tubers are milled. The result is a fine, aromatic powder with its natural earthy character. Many buyers want to buy nagarmotha powder wholesale for a range of uses. We keep batch records from raw tuber to export packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Whether you need small bulk lots or larger volumes, we can plan supply to fit.

Processing Standards

Good processing needs care, hygiene and consistency. At Tradenest Naturals, we pair traditional herbal knowledge with modern equipment. First, our team inspects the raw tubers. Then the tubers are washed to remove soil and foreign matter. After that, controlled dehydration helps keep the natural aroma. Our milling and sieving give an even mesh size. Most clients use our standard 80-100 mesh grade. Custom mesh sizes can be discussed on request. As a nagarmotha powder supplier, we use no synthetic chemicals in processing. Packed bags are sealed promptly to keep the powder dry.

Key Technical Specifications

Specifications decide how a powder performs in your product. Full details are on the specification sheet we send with each quotation. Here is a summary:
  • Botanical Name: Cyperus rotundus
  • Part Used: Tubers / Roots
  • Appearance: Fine brownish-grey powder
  • Aroma: Characteristic earthy, woody and warm scent
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 Mesh (custom sizes on request)
  • Moisture Content: Below 8%
  • Shelf Life: 24 months in cool, dry storage
  • Purity: Plain tuber powder with no additives

Applications Across Multiple Industries

The aroma and texture of nutgrass make it useful in many products. Brands buy nutgrass powder wholesale lots for a range of formulations. The cosmetic industry uses it in hair masks, dry shampoos and skin cleansers. Herbal brands include it in traditional Ayurvedic blends and capsules. Some spice blenders and food developers also explore its earthy flavour. Our competitive nagarmotha powder price per kg helps brands manage costs. Request a quote to see our volume pricing.
